Thanks for the ping. Quick legal notes after an initial review of DPA_draft_v2.docx: 

- DPA covers controller-processor relationship by default (standard for hosted + Dedicated). For Private/VPC, the draft includes an annex allowing controller-to-controller language if customer hosts and controls keys we should confirm which annex applies based on their deployment architecture.
- SCCs: we support the new EU SCCs; module selection will depend on whether Acme requires us to be a processor only. If they expect co-controller behavior (rare), we'll need to escalate and likely add specific data governance clauses.
- PHI/HIPAA: Redwood offers a HIPAA addendum for Private deployments; the DPA currently does not include HIPAA obligations. If Acme has PHI workloads, notify the HIPAA team that will extend timeline ~2-3 weeks for contract/legal review.

Action items:
- Neha: send back the DPA with a brief note outlining which deployment mode they expect (hosted vs VPC/on-prem) and whether PHI is in scope.
- Rishi: please attach the SOC2 summary in the next reply and confirm certificate validity dates for their review.

Regards,
